dishes.name: Heidschnuckenbraten
dishes.desc: Roast of Heidschnucke, the grey heath sheep of the Lüneburg Heath, with a strong gamey flavor, served with beans and potatoes.

dishes.name: Heath asparagus
dishes.desc: White asparagus grown in the sandy soils around Lüneburg and Celle, served with new potatoes, ham and butter in spring.

dishes.name: Buckwheat cake
dishes.desc: Layered cream cake with buckwheat flour and cranberry jam, baked on the Lüneburg Heath where buckwheat was grown on poor soil.

dishes.name: Calenberger Pfannenschlag
dishes.desc: Fried pork cuts with bacon, onions and herbs from the Calenberg farmland south of Hannover, eaten with kale or potatoes.

dishes.name: Lüneburg sugar cake
dishes.desc: Flat yeast cake with a crust of sugar, butter and cinnamon, a Lüneburg bakery staple.
